85613441.description: Hydronium perchlorate is an inorganic chemical compound with the chemical formula [H3O]ClO4.

86278273.name: Chlorotoxin
86278273.description: Chlorotoxin is a 36-amino acid peptide found in the venom of the deathstalker scorpion which blocks small-conductance chloride channels.

88730753.name: Progesterone 3-oxime
88730753.description: Progesterone 3-oxime , also known as 3- pregn-4-en-3-one, is a progesterone derivative which was never marketed.

101170561.name: Thioxoethenylidene
101170561.description: Thioxoethenylidene, is a reactive heteroallene molecule with formula CCS.

102025217.name: 1,2,3,4,5-Pentakis(4-butylphenyl)-1,3-cyclopentadiene
102025217.description: 1,2,3,4,5-Pentakis -1,3-cyclopentadiene is an organochemical compound from the diene group and a cyclopentadiene derivative.

119025665.name: MDMB-FUBINACA
119025665.description: MDMB-FUBINACA (also known as MDMB -Bz-F and FUB-MDMB) is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is a potent agonist for cannabinoid receptors and that has been sold online as a designer drug.

124037377.name: PTI-2
124037377.description: PTI-2 is an indole-based synthetic cannabinoid.

131704321.name: Octreotide scan
131704321.description: An octreotide scan is a type of SPECT scintigraphy used to find carcinoid, pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, and to localize sarcoidosis.

131873665.name: Lanthanum acetylacetonate
131873665.description: Lanthanum acetylacetonate refers to the coordination complex with the formula La 3.

134694273.name: Cotadutide
134694273.description: Cotadutide is an experimental drug for the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus.

138523649.name: Adibelivir
138523649.description: Adibelivir also known as IM-250 is an anti-herpetic drug candidate developed by Innovative Molecules Gmbh.

139134081.name: Potassium tetraperoxochromate(V)
139134081.description: Potassium peroxochromate, potassium tetraperoxochromate , or simply potassium perchromate, is an inorganic compound having the chemical formula K3[Cr 4].

139586689.name: Ergosecaline
139586689.description: Ergosecaline is an ergot alkaloid and ergopeptine found in Claviceps purpurea .

170843521.name: Lanthanum disilicide
170843521.description: Lanthanum disilicide is a binary inorganic compound of lanthanum metal and silicon with the formula LaSi2. Many other lanthanum silicides are known.

177845377.name: Α-Methylmelatonin
177845377.description: α-Methylmelatonin, also known as α-methyl-5-methoxy-N-acetyltryptamine, is a synthetic tryptamine derivative and analogue of the monoamine neurotransmitter melatonin.

900000001.name: (Pentamethylcyclopentadienyl)aluminium(I)
900000001.description: aluminium is an organometallic compound with the formula Al .

900000129.name: Alglucerase
900000129.description: Alglucerase was a biopharmaceutical drug for the treatment of Gaucher's disease.

900000257.name: Bedinvetmab
900000257.description: Bedinvetmab, sold under the brand name Librela, is a fully canine monoclonal antibody used for the control of pain associated with osteoarthritis in dogs.

900000385.name: Calfactant
900000385.description: Calfactant, also known as Infasurf, is an intratracheal suspension derived from the natural surfactant in calf lungs.

900000513.name: Covaxin
900000513.description: Covaxin is a whole inactivated virus-based COVID-19 vaccine developed by Bharat Biotech in collaboration with the Indian Council of Medical Research - National Institute of Virology.

900000769.name: Estradiol/megestrol acetate
900000769.description: Estradiol/megestrol acetate , sold under the brand names Mego-E and Chinese injectable No.

900000897.name: Glembatumumab vedotin
900000897.description: Glembatumumab vedotin is an antibody-drug conjugate that targets cancer cells expressing transmembrane glycoprotein NMB .

900001153.name: Lirentelimab
900001153.description: Lirentelimab (called AK002 during preclinical development) is a humanized nonfucosylated monoclonal antibody that targets sialic acid-binding Ig-like lectin 8 .

900001281.name: Mogamulizumab
900001281.description: Mogamulizumab, sold under the brand name Poteligeo, is a humanized, afucosylated monoclonal antibody targeting CC chemokine receptor type 4 .

900001409.name: Octaoxygen
900001409.description: Octaoxygen, also known as ε-oxygen or red oxygen, is an allotrope of oxygen consisting of eight oxygen atoms. This allotrope forms at room temperature at pressures between 10 and 96 GPa.

900001665.name: Polysulfated glycosaminoglycan
900001665.description: Polysulfated glycosaminoglycan is an injectable drug for dogs and horses that is used to alleviate the limpness, pain, and lowered range of motion caused by arthritis.

900001793.name: Rhenium trioxynitrate
900001793.description: Rhenium trioxynitrate, also known as rhenium trioxide nitrate, is a chemical compound with the formula ReO3NO3. It is a white solid that readily hydrolyzes in moist air.
